item.title: Pulse 3.0.0
item.description:
## Changes
- chore: 3.0.0 — Pulse Remote, pinnable Quick actions, PDF/Image/Developer tools and more - fix(remote-app): the screen view's input controller stays alive, so trackpad, touch, pinch and scroll reach the Mac - feat(hot-corners): PULSE_HOT_CORNERS=log traces configure, corner entry and each decision - feat(launcher): site search keywords (gh, yt, wiki, maps, npm, pub, mdn, translate) - chore(tools): analyzer tidy in battery tests - test(tools): new tools' Dart tests; keyboard layout forget row fits the smallest window - feat(launcher): date maths in the calculator row (today + 90 days, in 3 weeks, 2 ay sonra) - wip(tools): pins, readout, EN+TR strings - wip(tools): presenter natives, routing, xcode sync - feat(notch): Join for video meetings, a meeting peek and a download-finished peek - feat(notch): Copy code on notifications that carry a sign-in code - feat(launcher): every pinnable tool action is a launcher command, argument commands, ⌘K actions panel - feat(notch): the timer survives restarts and sleep, with shortcuts and actions - wip(tools): presenter dart side, keyboard layout natives - wip(tools): device batteries, hot corners, keyboard layout (in progress) - fix(remote): declare Local Network use so macOS can ask instead of silently dropping LAN connections - feat(notch): timer action ids shared by the launcher, pins and shortcuts - fix(remote): list Quick actions from the pin-era MenuToolAction catalog - fix(remote-mobile): Keychain that never answers, toolbar overflow, stat bars - chore: analyzer tidy (const rows, set literal) - fix(snippets,super-key): read the cached front app; read settings before awaiting - fix(updates): appcasts skip beta channels and versions this macOS cannot run - fix(uninstall): remove apps installed for all users; find leftovers outside ~/Library - test(remote): live end-to-end harness, chunked-body fix - fix(dmg-install): the old app is kept until the new one is in place; no leaked mounts - fix(toggles): eject off the main thread with reasons; Finder never restarted mid-copy - feat(remote): Pulse Remote phone app (Flutter, iOS + Android) - feat(remote): Pulse Remote tool page, settings and service - fix(dev-tools): QR content pills keep their natural width - fix(displays): DDC off the main thread; monitors matched by framebuffer, not order - fix(audio): a manual mic switch sticks; the mute follows the microphone - feat(tools): PULSE_FILES launch switch seeds the file tools' lists - fix(radial): starting items are named in Pulse's language - fix(super-key): keep other key mappings, send excluded apps, warn about Double Tap - fix(menubar): screenshot mode pins name their tool (Screenshot › Area) - fix(finder-keys): a pasted image is never lost or overwritten - feat(native): DevToolsBridge — file panels, Vision QR from image/screen, Text tools menu at the pointer - feat(launcher): developer answers source (uuid, epoch, colours, hashes, Base64, URL) with colour swatch - feat(tools): Developer category with Dev toolbox (17 sub-tools, smart paste) and Text tools - feat(ocr): choose the languages to read; default to the Mac's languages - test(tools): every PDF and image action lays out in EN/TR; native output per test - feat(tools): Automation permission rows for Finder and System Events - fix(snippets,clip-care): Pulse's own pasteboard writes stay out of clipboard history - feat(tools): PDF tools and Image tools in a new Files & documents category (WIP) - fix(snap): probe off the tap thread, coalesce drags, no false snap, Windows gap - fix(tools): click taps pre-filter by geometry and hit-test with a 0.1 s timeout - test(settings): Quick actions rows in a tall view - fix(notch): no lyrics for films in browsers; full-screen and media-source options - fix(notch): hide for macOS full screen on notched screens, borderless and video full screen - feat(menubar): pinnable Quick actions — catalog, saved pins, edit mode, settings, footer fit - fix(tools): tap tools start once Accessibility is granted, without Pulse becoming active - feat(remote): native listener for Pulse Remote (HTTP + WebSocket over Tailscale)
SHA-256: `6191c06210dd82e4fc7cccbec59f34e5cdfe99b57c0ba20b1f77a0a4a0787ffe`

item.title: Pulse 2.5.0
item.description:
## Changes
- chore: 2.5.0 — unified menu bar, notch pages, 20+ new tools, launcher filters and system apps - fix(launcher): a working calculation or conversion comes before Ask Pulse - fix(toggles): action tiles keep a fixed height instead of growing with the window - fix(launcher): apps rank above file hits named like the query, as in Spotlight - feat(notch): notifications page, sections gallery with search, live equalizer, idle content - feat(mouse): pointer speed slider while acceleration is off (scales the mouse's own resolution, restored at 1×) - feat(displays): brightness keys follow the pointer (monitors over DDC/CI), half/quarter steps, extra brightness on XDR panels - feat(mixer): per-app output device (experimental, off by default) on the existing tap routes - feat(audio): notch peek on output switch and mic mute, optional muted-mic dot on the menu bar icon - feat(mouse): three-finger trackpad click as a middle click - feat(mouse): pointer acceleration off for mice, previous value restored - feat(mouse): smooth scrolling — wheel notches glide, with distance and glide time - feat(tools): Displays — brightness for every display (DDC/CI for monitors), monitor speakers, extra dimming - feat(tools): Radial menu — a ring of apps and Pulse actions around the pointer - feat(tools): Media tools — convert images, compress videos, make GIFs, locally - feat(tools): Super key — Caps Lock (or right ⌘/⌥) as ⌃⌥⇧⌘, a tap sends Escape - feat(tools): Window snapping — edges and corners with a preview, modifier move and resize - feat(quit-guard): a ⇧ mode (only ⇧⌘Q quits) and guarding only listed apps - feat(tools): Green button fills the screen without a new Space; ⌥-click stays native - feat(tools): Dock clicks — clicking the front app's icon hides, minimizes or cycles it - feat(launcher): open windows as a source, unit conversions in the calculator - feat(tools): Text snippets — type a trigger, get the text; also in the launcher - feat(tools): Input filters — extra click filter and key debounce for worn hardware - feat(mouse): scroll sideways while holding a key, linear wheel scrolling - feat(tools): Finder shortcuts — cut and paste moves, F2 renames, paste an image as a PNG - feat(tools): App updates — Sparkle feeds, App Store (mas) and Homebrew in one list - feat(tools): Uninstaller — remove an app and what it left in Library - feat(notch): wire the 2.5 pages in; EN and TR strings; Xcode project - feat(tools): Scratchpad, a floating panel and a notch page - feat(notch): Controls page - feat(notch): Clipboard, Captures and Downloads pages - feat(notch): Calendar and Timer pages - feat(notch): page order, hidden pages, home page, letter keys and swipes - feat(tools): Audio devices — output switcher and microphone - feat(tools): Chat downloads — tidy what chat apps saved to Downloads - feat(tools): Disk image installer - feat(quit-guard): also guard ⌘W (close window or tab) - feat(native): one Pulse status item with a right-click menu; switching style adds and removes items - feat(settings): Menu bar style picker and unified icon options - feat(panel): unified dropdown with icon tabs (Live, Usage, Cleaner, Mixer, quick actions, tool switches) - feat(menubar): unified menu bar settings, readouts and main-engine sync - fix(tools): toggle shortcuts for keep awake, cleaning, mixer and camera match the full action id - feat(toggles): keep Spaces in order (restores the previous setting when off) - feat(live): LAN address and on-demand speed test in the network card - feat(tools): Clipboard care — auto clear and link cleaning - feat(tools): Quick toggles and Port manager - feat(launcher): system apps, System Settings panes, #type and @folder filters
SHA-256: `aeb31e246721bf9202f9df046e953e5b4230c7c5212a8703915c422ed4c65f1a`

item.title: Pulse 2.3.0
item.description:
## Changes
- chore: 2.3.0 — ChatGPT subscription as Pulse's AI (through the Codex CLI), faster Stop, Pulse's tool token out of the process list - fix(agent): Codex setup failures end the run, stop during start, keychain store status, CODEX_HOME fallback, race-safe auth link, private prompt files - fix(agent): the Claude run token reaches pulse-mcp through env, never argv - fix(agent): stop kills the CLI first; a stream error or early end no longer leaves a run running - fix(agent): a Codex tool call with status failed (isError) is a tool error, not a success - fix(agent): a stop during Codex setup keeps codex from starting - feat(agent): ChatGPT subscription as an agent provider through the Codex CLI

item.title: Pulse 2.2.0
item.description:
## Changes
- chore: 2.2.0 — the people in your life with per-chat digests, your companies and which projects belong to each, no more false project links; Ollama no longer hangs, no repeated keychain prompts - refactor(knowledge): the night's synthesis step in its own class - fix(people): two kept windows make a real relationship; a fuller person page title counts - fix(people): digest calls go round the top chats; a window read again is not folded twice - fix(work): projects resolve by folder; one organisation per project; marks that cannot be done stop waking synthesis - feat(work): generic topics outside projects stay topics; no nightly synthesis for private org pages - feat(work): organisation pages, Part of links and org-scoped graph edges - chore(people): reuse the relation hints label; drop an unused test import - feat(people): synthesis writes people pages from stats and chat digests - feat(nightly): the chat digest step after triage, counted in the report - feat(entities): organisations from git owners and folders; one-time work migration - feat(people): rolling chat digests written by the local model - feat(store): chat_digests table, one rolling digest per top chat - feat(store): orgs and page_rewrites tables, entity repo roots - feat(people): ~150-word specific summaries for chats, threads and mail; top contacts' DMs kept for any substance - feat(sources): read the origin remote from the git config file, and the user's commit share - feat(people): chat sources read the user's top chats first - feat(entities): a project is its repo root; no generic or shared aliases - docs: Knowledge 2.2 spec — people digests, organisations, no false links - fix(learning): read Ollama's output so it never hangs on a full log pipe - fix(usage): read Claude Code's token through the security tool so macOS stops asking
SHA-256: `79bc1de448b2e286342b71a77c0ad8167ab711d469abb7db54d47659fd3ec539`

item.title: Pulse 2.1.0
item.description:
## Changes
- chore: 2.1.0 — people and relationships, per-person Double Tap with the swirl, Brief knows your plans, 8 GB memory limit - fix(knowledge): re-arm the nightly hour and wake after it fires; a held start does not cancel the model download - feat(knowledge): Pulse stays under its memory limit with its model, and no surprise runs - feat(draft): a dramatic Double Tap swirl on the reply box itself - feat(brief): pin the user's own commitments due within 48 h; listings retire - feat(calendar): tell the user's plans from public listings; exams are deadlines - feat(knowledge): relation hints reach synthesis, unnamed chats stay out of the people digest - feat(knowledge): people pages and the user's circle from chat stats, Learn everything now - feat(draft): read the chat header texts above the reply field for the recipient - feat(draft): per-recipient Double Tap voice from the user's own chat messages - feat(knowledge): DM and group triage keep relationships, record group nature, re-read old chat windows once - feat(knowledge): contact stats from WhatsApp and Messages, contacts table, triage prompt versions - docs: Knowledge 2.1 calibration spec (people, per-recipient Double Tap, Brief) - Add Pulse 2.0.0 landing page and Impeccable design system
SHA-256: `c90ddf953e47a366a14787d71293a556cda599ec7c43e747672b0d06c7224aa2`

item.title: Pulse 2.0.0
item.description:
## Changes
- chore: 2.0.0 — Knowledge 2: two-tier learning, Brief reminders, Double Tap, knowledge graph - fix(graph): no twin dot for an entity that has its own page - feat(graph): canvas-shaped ring, fit on open, night-sky look - feat(graph): co-source edges and entity satellites from the knowledge store - fix(knowledge): repo window keys hash the folder path - fix(knowledge): engine safety — retryable triage failures, no page tails lost, deny list on every cloud path - fix(brief): deny list on every cloud send, live switch, failed builds keep cards, bounded actions, calendar snapshots supersede, atomic notification replace - fix(knowledge): a capped run gives every source a turn - fix(knowledge): no reminders from instructions to coding assistants - feat(brief): morning look starts the model only when a build is needed - feat(brief): reminders judge, verify pass, local picker, cards and notifications - test(knowledge): read-failure note carries the error kind only - fix(knowledge): name a source whose read fails in the nightly notes - test(knowledge): set literal in the T3 no-repeat check - fix(draft): timestamped tap detection, preview closes on leaving, re-checked insert, honest clipboard restore - fix(knowledge): per-group Gmail frontiers, T3 open turns and agent prompts, mail order and dedupe, visible read failures - fix(agent): send Claude CLI prompts on stdin, not argv - docs(knowledge): when the runner unloads the local model - fix(knowledge): redact summaries again for the cloud, guard stuck cursors - feat(knowledge): learning engine v2: entities, synthesis, runner and the switch - feat(graph): Knowledge › Graph tab — painter, hover/click/pan/zoom, search, folder chips, side panel - feat(vault): clickable wiki links and a Backlinks section in the reader - feat(knowledge): summary store, local model clients and window triage - feat(graph): graph, layout cache, backlinks and view-state providers - feat(graph): wiki link resolution, graph build and seeded force layout - refactor(knowledge): name window separator widths - refactor(draft): name the native relay arguments and skip reasons - feat(native): calendar snapshot with reminders, sorted and collapsed - feat(knowledge): source windows with two-frontier cursors - feat(draft): native Double Tap detector, context reader, preview and paste - feat(draft): Double Tap drafting service, retrieval, prompt and settings card - docs: Knowledge 2 spec (Sentient OS parity and beyond)
